metadata.title: Four Days, No Dependencies
metadata.subtitle: A git-explainer walkthrough of guillaumemeyer/watermarks-remover — stdlib Python strips multi-vendor AI provenance marks in four days
metadata.purpose: Walk the guillaumemeyer/watermarks-remover GitHub repo with real git/wc data. Show the three-tier architecture, four-day commit history, ethics.md scope document, binary-guard HEAD commit, and stdlib-only dependency graph. The thesis: the marks a major lab shipped worldwide come off with re and unicodedata. Rung 1 throughout — all data from the local clone at books/github/watermarks-remover HEAD 256d90d.
metadata.skill: git-explainer (descends from code-walkthrough; Claude bookends from ai-explainer)
metadata.source: guillaumemeyer/watermarks-remover cloned 2026-08-14; HEAD 256d90d. All data computed via git log, wc -l, git grep, git show. See REPO-VERIFY.md.
metadata.notes: Kokoro am_onyx, free. GATE P before any audio spend. Six GitHub skin scenes in fixed order: RepoHero, StructureMap, CallChain, Churn, CodeViewer, CodeDiff. Four Manim beats: B07 LOC hotspot, B12 import fan, B17 four-day churn, B33 dependency count. Three narrations locked: B18 (CHURN), B22 (READ GATE), BVDT (VERDICT). ethics.md quoted verbatim at five byte-exact ranges per REPO-VERIFY.md. KGW arclabel: this is the fourth piece — Nature paper, forensic-readiness score, KGW reference, counter-tool. Never publish.

beats.narration_text: The file we want to read is not a strip implementation. It is ethics.md — the scope document the agent loads before doing anything. 32 lines. Shorter than any of the strip implementations. Read it.

lines: # Intended use
This skill removes machine-readable provenance marks and hygiene
problems from content **you own or are authorized to process**.
## Appropriate
- Privacy: strip tool/device/AI provenance from your own files before sharing
- Engineering hygiene: remove invisible Unicode that breaks diffs, search, or paste
- Research: understand how text and C2PA marks work across vendors
- Cleaning your own drafts where policy allows unmarked local copies
## Not appropriate
- Academic fraud or misrepresenting AI assistance where disclosure is required
- Circumventing lawful transparency or platform disclosure rules
- Claiming cleaned content is "human-written" for compliance theater
A removed mark does **not** mean the content was never AI-assisted.
Use this toolkit honestly.
props.caption: 32 lines — the document the agent loads. Shorter than any strip implementation.

beats.narration_text: A removal tool that ships a document telling you removal proves nothing is making the same argument this channel has been making all week from the other direction. The detector's silence is not evidence of absence — and neither is the remover's success.
